sources.label: Official product page
facts: Plus V2 light strip width is 2.1 mm
construction includes UV-resistant coating, side light strip, silicone/TPE cable, single-layer cable and stable clips
24-pin dimensions are 267 mm x 56.6 mm x 8 mm

sources.label: Official exploded/side images
visual_cues: flat ribbon assembly, not a round cable bundle
parallel RGB light guides above pale single-row power cables
black connector blocks and black branded clamp
visible stable clips and translucent alignment combs

sources.label: Official controller page
facts: L-Connect 3 controls Strimer Plus V2 lighting effects
24-pin and triple 8-pin expose 6 channels; dual 8-pin exposes 4 channels
controller supports one 24-pin motherboard cable plus one GPU cable

required_geometry: 12 continuous light guides for the 24-pin variant
120 addressable LED cells represented as runtime-emissive material segments
bonded silicone/TPE core joining lower cables, diffusers and LED cells with no visible air gap in side or underside view
2x12 socket grid on the 24-pin connector face
2x12 input contact pins on the opposite connector face
stable black clips and translucent alignment clips
side light strips on both outer edges

rejected_fakes: single emissive plane with no per-guide structure
floating stacked layers visible from the side or underside
free pigtail cables attached to the connector instead of a connector face
